FIELD NOTES
  • Destroy the boss at the end of each mission to clear it and unlock the next. Watch your health bar: every hit drains it.
  • Rescue survivors by walking up to them. Each one drops supplies. Save all of them for a star.
  • Supply cases give special weapons, bombs, armor and health. Walk into a tank or helicopter to drive it.
  • A red laser means a hostile is about to fire. Crouch under the shot or jump it.
  • Red fuel tanks explode when shot. Let hostiles walk up to one first, and keep your distance.
  • With the mouse, click where you want to shoot: in front, behind you or straight up.
  • Spend credits in the Gunsmith to buy guns, upgrade them and fit attachments.
01 FALCONBalanced. Fast machine gun.
02 BLAZEFastest runner. Rapid carbine.
03 RHINOSlow. Explosive rounds. Armor soaks up the first hit.
04 ECHOQuick. Slow rifle that shoots through a whole line.
